title: Nzvimbo Yokuzorora Yega
intro: Munhoroondo dzenyasha dzaMwari, mune mweya wakachena zvikuru, wakaparadzaniswa nevanhu vavo kuti vatsvage kuva vega munzira tsvene. Vaisaziva kuti kuva vega uku kwaizounza chiratidzo kunyika dzese, muedzo wekutenda waizotaurwa nezvawo nekusingaperi.
clues: Ndakanga ndakazvipira kuhupenyu hwangu hwekushandira Mwari ndisati ndaberekwa.
Ndakaiswa pasi pekuchengetedzwa kwemuporofita ane chiremera.
Ndakatsigirwa nezvinhu zvakabva kuna Allah zvakashamisa muchengeti wangu.
Ndakasiya mhuri yangu ndikaenda kunzvimbo yekumabvazuva.
Ngirozi yakaonekwa kwandiri iri muchimiro chemunhu akakwana, ichindiunzira nhau dzemwanakomana akachena.
Pandakadzoka nemwana wangu achangoberekwa, vanhu vangu vakandipomera mhosva, asi mwana wacho akataura achindidzivirira.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
